evidence: The XRD patterns obtained from the films as-deposited by PEALD are shown in Fig. 3. Several XRD peaks reflected from (111), (200), (220), and (311) oriented cubic TaN are detected and the peak intensities gradually increase with the pulse time of hydrogen plasma. This means that the as-deposited Ta-N films become polycrystallized more and more as the exposure time to hydrogen plasma increases, while the films formed by the typical ALD remain at an amorphous phase.
